def apply_batch(state, events):
    balances = dict(state["balances"])
    seen = set(state["seen"])
    for event in events:
        if event["id"] in seen:
            continue
        account = event["account"]
        updated = balances.get(account, 0) + event["delta"]
        if updated < 0:
            return False
        balances[account] = updated
        seen.add(event["id"])
    state["balances"] = balances
    state["seen"] = seen
    return True
